title: Micah Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Micah 3: the rulers who hate the good, the prophets who sell their message, and Zion plowed like a field.

questions.text: What does the speaker ask the heads of Jacob and the rulers of Israel?
questions.explanation: He asks them to listen, and asks whether it is not for them to know justice.

answers.text: Whether they will go out to war
Whether they still keep the feasts
Whether they will build the wall
Whether it is not for them to know justice

questions.text: What image does verse 3 use for what they do to the people?
questions.explanation: They eat the flesh of his people, break their bones and chop them in pieces, as for the pot and as meat within the cauldron.

answers.text: Grapes trodden in the winepress
Meat chopped for the pot and cauldron
Grain threshed on the floor
Sheep scattered on the hills

questions.text: What will happen when they cry to Yahweh?
questions.explanation: They will cry to Yahweh, but he will not answer them, and he will hide his face from them at that time.

answers.text: He will send them a new prophet
He will answer from his temple
He will not answer and will hide his face
He will forgive them at once

questions.text: What do the prophets of verse 5 proclaim to those who feed them?
questions.explanation: Of those who feed their teeth they proclaim, “Peace!”, and against whoever does not provide for their mouths they prepare war.

answers.text: Peace
Judgment
Famine
Repentance

questions.text: What does verse 6 say will come over these prophets?
questions.explanation: Night is over them with no vision, the sun will go down on the prophets and the day will be black over them.

answers.text: Rain and a mighty storm of hail
Night with no vision and a black day
A famine of bread and of water
A flood rising out of the sea

questions.text: Why will the seers and diviners cover their lips?
questions.explanation: The seers will be disappointed and the diviners confounded, and they will all cover their lips, for there is no answer from God.

answers.text: Because the king has silenced them
Because they are ashamed of their gold
Because there is no answer from God
Because the city has been burned

questions.text: What does the speaker say he himself is full of?
questions.explanation: He says he is full of power by Yahweh's Spirit, and of judgment and might, to declare to Jacob his disobedience and to Israel his sin.

answers.text: Power by Yahweh's Spirit, judgment and might
Sorrow and fear in the face of the rulers
Wisdom received from the elders of Jacob
Words of peace for the house of Israel

questions.text: With what does verse 10 say they build up Zion?
questions.explanation: They build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.

answers.text: With cedar
With gold
With sand
With blood

questions.text: What does verse 11 say the priests do?
questions.explanation: Her leaders judge for bribes, her priests teach for a price, and her prophets tell fortunes for money.

answers.text: They refuse to teach at all
They teach for a price
They tear their robes in grief
They flee out of the city

questions.text: What does the last verse say will happen to Zion?
questions.explanation: Zion will be plowed like a field, Jerusalem will become heaps of rubble, and the mountain of the temple will be like the high places of a forest.

answers.text: It will be built with cedar
It will be filled with people
It will be plowed like a field
It will be covered by the sea
